note: This exact contract, once recorded here, was not altered for the duration of this run. No anchor, weight, dimension definition, or missing-evidence rule was adjusted mid-run.
dimension_architecture: 28 dimensions across 6 pillars, unchanged from the canonical spec: Market(5) Team(5) Product(5) Execution(4) Traction(5) Financial Health(4).

numerical_anchors_applied.unit_economics: 6 business-model evidence families with named primary/supporting metrics and insufficient-combination rules (Part 4)
numerical_anchors_applied.burn_efficiency: quantitative burn-multiple bands (unused, 0/15) + qualitative 5-band fallback gated on direct, non-hedged, company-specific evidence (Part 5)
numerical_anchors_applied.runway: quantitative months-of-runway bands (unused, 0/15) + qualitative 6-band fallback gated the same way (Part 6)

provisional_anchors_in_effect_unchanged: Growth Velocity / Customer Growth scale-tier absolute cutoffs
Qualitative Burn Efficiency exact score-within-band placements
missing_evidence_rules: Nine canonical states (spec Part 4), unchanged: not_expected_by_stage, not_applicable, optional_unavailable, usually_private_unavailable, expected_unavailable, research_failure, explicit_management_refusal, conflicting_evidence, mixed_evidence. Usually-Private and Expected-But-Unavailable remain arithmetically identical, differing only in diligence-flag severity.
aggregation_rules: Weighted average over the scored set only, per-pillar and per-company renormalization to the scored subset's weights (spec Part 9), unchanged. No confidence or coverage penalty applied to the SPS number itself (per this run's explicit instruction) -- coverage and confidence remain separate, displayed metadata, not multipliers on SPS.
